# APSAS Requirements

## Context

The Automated Programming Skills Assessment System (APSAS) is a platform that automates code evaluation, skill assessment, and personalized feedback for programming assignments. APSAS delivers immediate, detailed feedback to students and streamlines performance monitoring for instructors, enhancing learning outcomes and reducing manual workload.

## Functional Requirements

### Student

- Register/login to access system.
- Submit programming assignments.
- Receive immediate feedback on coding submissions.
- Track personal skill progression over time.
- View deadlines and assignment schedules.
- Access resources and coding tutorials.
- Request immediate support from instructors if needed.

### Instructor/Lecturer

- Register/login to manage student performance.
- Review automated evaluation results and feedback generated by the system.
- Provide additional personal feedback directly to students.
- Manage assignment schedules and deadlines.
- Receive alerts for students who need urgent assistance.

### Course Content Provider

- Login to the system.
- Create/update/delete programming challenges and tutorials.
- Manage educational resources and documentation for student reference.
- Integrate new learning content and skill assessment modules.

### System Administrator

- Manage user accounts and system security.
- Maintain and update software components.
- Manage integrations with external APIs and services.

## Other Requirements

- Architecture: Microservices
- Code Execution API: Piston (https://github.com/engineer-man/piston)
